# Bunker - PSG & CEG Attendance Tracker

> Bunker is the #1 free attendance tracker and bunk planner for students at PSG College of Technology (PSG Tech), PSG Institute of Advanced Studies (PSG IAS), and College of Engineering Guindy (CEG / Anna University).

## What is Bunker?

Bunker is a smart web app that helps college students:
- Track their live attendance from eCampus and CeGov portals
- Calculate how many classes they can safely skip ("bunk") while staying above mandatory attendance (75% for exams, 80% safe planning for PSG Tech)
- View their internal marks, GPA, and CGPA (PSG Tech)
- Simulate future attendance scenarios with a date simulator
- Get academic calendar, exam schedules, and holiday lists

## URL

https://psg-bunk.vercel.app/

## Supported Colleges

1. **PSG College of Technology (PSG Tech)** — Roll numbers like 22CSA01 — Portal: ecampus.psgtech.ac.in — Min: 75% exam / 80% bunk planning
2. **PSG Institute of Advanced Studies (PSG IAS)** — Roll numbers like 25IR007 — Portal: ecampus.psgias.ac.in — Min: 75%
3. **College of Engineering Guindy (CEG / Anna University)** — Roll numbers like 2023103001 (10 digits) — Portal: www.auegov.ac.in — Min: 75%

## Key Features

- **Live Portal Sync**: Pulls real attendance data directly from eCampus (PSG Tech, PSG IAS) and CeGov (CEG) portals
- **Safe Bunk Calculator**: Tells you exactly how many classes you can skip and still maintain required attendance
- **Attendance Simulator**: Travel to any date to simulate your future attendance
- **Internal Marks**: View all CA marks, test scores, and assignment marks subject-wise (PSG Tech)
- **GPA & CGPA Viewer**: See semester-wise GPA and cumulative CGPA with color-coded chips (PSG Tech)
- **Academic Calendar**: Holiday lists, exam schedules, and semester dates (PSG Tech)
- **Smart Planner**: Day-wise timetable with quick attendance marking
- **Works Offline**: Fully offline-capable Progressive Web App (PWA)
- **Android App**: Native APK available for download at /static/bunker.apk
- **iOS Support**: Add to Home Screen on iPhone via Safari for a native app feel

## FAQ

**Q: What is Bunker?**
A: Bunker (also called "Smart Bunker" or "PSG Bunker") is a free web app for PSG Tech, PSG IAS, and CEG students to track attendance and plan bunks safely.

**Q: How many classes can I bunk?**
A: Bunker calculates this for you. The minimum required attendance is 75%. The app tells you the exact number of classes you can skip per subject.

**Q: Is Bunker free?**
A: Yes, Bunker is completely free for all students.

**Q: Where can I find Bunker?**
A: Visit https://psg-bunk.vercel.app/ in any browser. You can also install it as a PWA on Android or iPhone.

**Q: Does Bunker work offline?**
A: Yes. Once your data is synced, the app works fully offline.

**Q: Which colleges are supported?**
A: PSG College of Technology (PSG Tech), PSG Institute of Advanced Studies (PSG IAS), and College of Engineering Guindy (CEG / Anna University).
